description: This file defines internal classes implementing reference-based equality comparers for objects and generic classes constrained to reference types, utilizing RuntimeHelpers for hash code generation.

classes.name: ReferenceEqualsComparer
classes.description: Implements IEqualityComparer<object> to compare objects by reference.

classes.name: ReferenceEqualsComparer<T>
classes.description: Generic class implementing IEqualityComparer<T> for reference types, comparing objects by reference.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines if two objects or references are the same instance using object.ReferenceEquals.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the object's reference, or 0 if null, using RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode.
